description.zh: 要查询的BGP邻居所在BGP组的ID。
description.en: The ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer that you want to query belongs.
The ID of the BGP peer that you want to query.

description.zh:
是否是默认BGP组。取值：


- **true**：是默认BGP组。

- **false**：不是默认BGP组。
description.en:
Specifies whether the BGP group is the default group. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1 to 50**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
要查询的BGP邻居所在BGP组的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the BGP group to which the BGP peer that you want to query belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

description.zh: 要查询的BGP邻居关联的VBR ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual border router (VBR) that is associated with the BGP peer that you want to query.

title.zh: 查询指定地域下的BGP邻居

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-bgp-peers --router-id vbr-2zecmmvg5gvu8i4te0000 --bgp-peer-id bgp-2ze3un0ft1jd1xd0000 --bgp-group-id bgpg-2zev8h2wo414sfh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-default false --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
